_README.purpose: Simulated dynamic world state. Describes the scenario, never a real organisation's behaviour.
_README.hard_rule: Anonymous recipient_/driver_ IDs only. A real organisation name must never appear as a key or value in this file.
_README.clock: All times are scenario-time. The simulated clock advances at a configurable multiplier so a rescue spanning an hour records inside a five-minute video.
_README.determinism: Same seed, same run. This is what makes the demo replayable and the trace auditable.
_README.same_code: All three seeds are executed by the identical coordinator. No branch anywhere reads the seed name.
_README.capability_replies: Simulated answers to confirmation queries. A recipient/field absent here means no reply arrives: the unknown stays unknown, the candidate is eliminated, and the loop replans. That is not an escalation while other candidates remain.

seed_01_clean_rescue.label: Straightforward rescue
seed_01_clean_rescue.demonstrates: Happy path with a real safety gate still doing visible work.
seed_01_clean_rescue.expected_narrative: recipient_002 and recipient_007 answer fastest and have ample capacity, but both are eliminated before ranking - 007 at the reg. 5(1) licence gate, 002 at the reg. 5(2) facilities and Sch. I 2(6) refrigeration gates for perishable food. recipient_001 takes all 40. driver_003 is nearest but has no temperature control, failing Sch. I 2(2); driver_001 carries insulated containers and goes. The agent must also apply pick-up and use-by date marking, since container_date_marked is false.

seed_02_split_replan.label: Capacity shortfall forces a replan
seed_02_split_replan.demonstrates: Replanning from state rather than a hardcoded fallback. The first viable recipient cannot take the whole load.
seed_02_split_replan.expected_narrative: recipient_001 accepts but can take only 15 of 40. The agent must not stop at a partial rescue. recipient_005 has unknown reheating capability; the agent confirms it (true), then recipient_005 declines anyway - a confirmed-capable recipient can still refuse, and neither event is an escalation. The agent regenerates candidates and places the remaining 25 with recipient_003. Both legs require a temperature-controlled vehicle.

expected_outcome.note: One confirmation step is acceptable here and should be logged as a confirmation, not an escalation.

seed_03_transport_escalation.label: No lawful transport before the deadline
seed_03_transport_escalation.demonstrates: Correct escalation. A willing recipient exists, so the failure is not the absence of demand.
seed_03_transport_escalation.expected_narrative: recipient_001 accepts all 40 within a workable window. Transport is the binding constraint: driver_003 is available and fast but carries no temperature control (Sch. I 2(2)); driver_004 has refrigeration but is not sanitised, failing regardless of load. Both temperature-capable sanitised vehicles are unavailable. The agent cannot lawfully complete this and must escalate with the specific reason, the identified recipient, the time remaining, and the options a human could authorise.

expected_outcome.escalation_reason: No available vehicle satisfies Sch. I 2(2) transport conditions for perishable food before the 19:00 consumption deadline.
human_options: Authorise a non-perishable-only partial handoff if any part of the load qualifies
Extend by sourcing an insulated container to pair with driver_003
Stand down the rescue and direct the donor to Sch. I 2(4) disposal handling

metrics_rollup.note: Report across all three seeds. This is the honest version of the headline number.
metrics_rollup.framing: Do not report 100 percent success. Two autonomous completions and one correct refusal is the stronger claim, because the refusal is the behaviour the brief asks for.
